historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved the demolition of a one-story-over-garage, single-family dwelling at 1070 Sanchez Street.
A one-story-over-garage, single-family dwelling stood at the property.
The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and approved, as modified, the construction of a three-story-over-garage, two-family dwelling at 1070 Sanchez Street.
